name: PRINCESS WALTZ
source:
The Princess Waltz - a competition of dance of whirling blades held to find the princess most worthy of becoming the new queen of Seven Central. Hopeful candidates travel from corners of the kingdoms of Eldelant to take part in the "waltz", but only one princess will be crowned. But this world is unknown to Arata, a modern-day guy who understands princesses even less than he does dancing. He is more concerned about the rumors swimming across his school about the new transfer student, Chris Northfield. The rumors about him being a prince seem to make no sense, because why would such a polite and accomplished boy attend this school? Arata's curiosity gets the better of him and gets pulled into something deeper than he'd ever imagine.

[From [url=https://jastusa.com/games/p015/]JAST USA[/url]]
translation:
公主华尔兹——一场旋转利刃之舞的竞赛，旨在寻找最配成为七之中心新女王的公主。满怀希望的候选人从艾尔德兰特王国的各个角落前来参加“华尔兹”，但只有一位公主将被加冕。然而这个世界对新来说是陌生的——这个现代男孩对公主的了解甚至还不如对舞蹈。他更关心的是学校里关于新转学生克里斯·诺斯菲尔德的传言。关于他是王子的传言似乎说不通，因为这样一个彬彬有礼、才华横溢的男孩为什么要来这所学校？新的好奇心占了上风，他被卷入了远超他想象的深渊之中。

[引自[url=https://jastusa.com/games/p015/]JAST USA[/url]]
